overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance data clearly indicates that space and exoplanet anomalies—specifically 'What If' scenarios and extreme planetary weather environments—are driving the highest views-per-day and engagement metrics (likes-per-view). Videos focusing on bizarre cosmic bodies (e.g., IYuce8vaU3Y 'Liquid Diamond Planet', A9Qa-RmuOr0 'Venus Day Longer Than Year', and v1rrcZLdp4U 'Planet Darker Than Coal') outperform standard biology or generic psychology facts by a significant margin. Engagement thrives on high-concept, highly visual hooks that challenge common assumptions.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (A9Qa-RmuOr0) generated over 950-1,000+ views rapidly with strong like ratios.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on surreal planetary environments, focusing on bizarre physics, extreme weather (e.g., supersonic gems, liquid metal), and immersive second-person 'What If' phrasing.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Why Your Head Is Older Than Your Feet' (c_ya3kvpuoI) and 'The Planet of Burning Ice' (vWd0uYcEGh4) maintain strong consistent traffic exceeding 1,000 views.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more short-form concepts that merge astrophysics with everyday relativistic paradoxes that force viewers to re-evaluate their physical reality.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (2fqaGqfsR4A) and 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' (Jc04LVKNd2s) showed flat or negligible traction under 20-50 views.
weak_patterns.action: Pivot away from generic cognitive psychology trivia unless paired with a high-stakes, unconventional narrative hook.

weak_patterns.pattern: Sub-20s Biology Standard Facts without a Twist
weak_patterns.evidence: Standard animal facts like basic octopus trivia or immortal jellyfish posts underperformed relative to cosmic horror and extreme planetary physics.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid straightforward factual statements about animals; if covering biology, frame it through extreme survival, prehistoric scaling, or bizarre evolutionary anomalies.
